scope: PR420 movable/resizable Settings and shared feature dialogs

adapter_scope: clamp whole dialog to client window
implementation.geometry_lifetime: open dialog only; close/reopen restores usual geometry
excluded: bespoke panels not using the shared feature painter

repair_history: Title-drag test begins its captured drag inside the window before crossing the edge, matching Bevy drag-start semantics.
Settings Retry fixture now uses real Bevy hierarchy/layout/stack with TimePlugin rather than top-level-only mock rectangles.
Earlier failed runs and lock-poison cascades remain in logs; each failed case was rechecked successfully.

Real V7 GUI startup exposed duplicate DialogPlugin installation through DefaultPlugins. bafaf561 guards registration and adds installs_with_bevys_dialog_plugin_already_present. All three dialog tests, strict Clippy, release build and real V8 GUI startup passed.
source_checks.validation_scope: 108 distinct focused cases across retained runs; the three dialog tests, strict release library/test Clippy and release build were rerun after the startup fix. Prior unaffected passes retained.

live_ui.input_method: Native macOS CUA only; read-only MCP inspection/capture verifies rendered effects. File reads verify saved model; no MCP mutations.

cases.expected: Title moves Settings; corner changes size without losing controls.
cases.actual: Settings moved from (440,80) to (315,145) UI pixels and resized from 480x700 to 620x460; content reflowed and footer stayed visible.

cases.expected: Resized content remains reachable by scrolling.
cases.actual: At 468x546, wheel scrolling reached interface size and GPU options; previous/next availability updated. This case did not separately exercise scrolling after a title translation.

cases.expected: Tab moves forward and Shift-Tab reverses within Settings.
cases.actual: Tab focused Close settings, another Tab focused 3D mouse speed, and Shift-Tab returned to Close settings; focus stayed in the modal.

cases.expected: Interface size changes preserve usable content and footer.
cases.actual: 125% selected, readable content and footer inside the window; restored 100% afterward.

cases.expected: Closing and reopening discards floating geometry.
cases.actual: Close button and footer bounds returned exactly to default positions after the moved/resized dialog was closed.

cases.expected: Moving/resizing retains draft values, selected profiles and a clear canvas distance field.
cases.actual: Existing 12 mm feature edited to a 14 mm draft; title moved -250,+50 UI pixels, width grew 320 to 425 and height decreased by 133. Both distance fields stayed 14, Merge profiles stayed selected, and the canvas field moved left to avoid the panel.

cases.expected: Lower options remain reachable with Apply/Cancel visible.
cases.actual: Wheel scrolling in the moved/resized form exposed Taper angle and Flip direction while retaining the footer.

cases.expected: Cancel discards the resized dialog draft.
cases.actual: Reopening the existing feature showed 12 in both distance fields and Merge profiles selected.

cases.expected: Another shared form respects window bounds, minimum width, validation and Cancel.
cases.actual: Rightward title drag clamped the 320-wide form to x=1032 in a 1360-wide window (8 px margin). Shrinking stopped at 280 UI px wide. Angle remained 360; missing-profile Apply stayed disabled. Cancel returned to the unchanged model.

cases.expected: Apply from a translated dialog works; Undo and Save restore the original model.
cases.actual: Coordinate-clicked translated Apply. Saved model contained distance 14. Undo and Save restored distance 12, two valid history features and byte-identical model.json.

cases.expected: Current app, inspection and saved fixture survive disposable-build cleanup.
cases.actual: Live capture succeeded with clean matching GUI/MCP revision 3a688963; saved model SHA-256 still matches the baseline after removing the rebuild target and obsolete V7 app.

cases.expected: Every title/corner drag starts at its handle and never activates the backdrop or another control.
cases.actual: Basic drags pass, but some large CUA gestures are inconsistent: a second title drag dismissed Settings and one large resize focused Light without changing dimensions. Product behavior versus input delivery/event batching is unresolved; no workaround added.
reproduction: At 100%, open centered Settings, click title at native screenshot (1150,270), drag to (550,270), then capture completed frame.
Drag from the now-visible title (550,270) to (30,270). Native accessibility reported the dialog removed and File focused.
Separate reopened attempt: prime corner (1824,1608), drag to (1300,650). Settings stayed 480x700 and Light gained focus. Shorter corner drag to (1800,1300) subsequently resized correctly.
cases.next_hypothesis: Check native input delivery and Bevy picking when press/move/release are coalesced by the idle host; distinguish this from ordinary human dragging before altering standard handling.
cases.repair_policy: Bounded initial investigation; unresolved item recorded while unaffected cases were completed.

cases.reason: Minimum height has source coverage; an exact live minimum-height boundary was not established.
Host window resizing after moving a dialog was not exercised live; source bounds/UI-scale tests passed.

prior_blockers: Mac lock cleared after user confirmation.
V7 GUI startup failure fixed by bafaf561; V7 headless initialization had not qualified GUI startup.
live_ui.visual_comparison: Themed controls, title/content/footer structure and canvas annotation remain similar. Extra resize corner and scroll arrows are acceptable differences. Large-gesture issue is functional and not accepted as cosmetic.
